ggvmap: Voronoi Map Treemaps for ggplot2

Source: R/ggvmap-package.R
ggvmap-package.Rd

Compute and visualise Voronoi map treemaps – space-filling partitions of convex polygons where each cell's area is proportional to an underlying weight. The algorithm iteratively adapts site positions and power-diagram weights until convergence, following the approach of Nocaj and Brandes (2012) doi:10.1111/j.1467-8659.2012.03078.x . Supports hierarchical (grouped) layouts, a decorative outer annotation ring, and flag / image / value annotations. Pure R implementation with no compiled-code dependencies and first-class ggplot2 integration.
